```{r Load, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(vegan) # for NMDS, RDA, and PERMANOVA 
library(lme4) # for GLMs
library(performance) # for check_model  
library(DHARMa) # for simulating residuals
library(glmmTMB) # for glmmTMB

# pollen data
pollen_samples <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_samples_data_cleaned.csv')

# nest-level data summary
beehav_sum <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Behaviour_nest_summary_cleaned.csv')

# nest-level data all social statuses
beehav_full <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Behaviour_nest_full_cleaned.csv')

# pollen_samples and behaviour data
pollen_beehav <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Pollen_and_behaviour_fam_cleaned.csv')

# abundance data
pollen_samples_abundance <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_samples_abundance_cleaned.csv')
pollen_samples_abundance_fam <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_samples_abundance_fam_cleaned.csv')


# set theme
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 15))

```

```{r Sociality, include=FALSE}

table(beehav_sum$Num_females_same_day)
# ignore: 11 nests had 0 observed females partaking in nest care
# 36 had 1 female at a given time partaking in nest care
# 3 nests had 2 females
# 2 nests had 3 females
# (2+3) / (36+2+3) = 12% are social
# including the liberal estimate, we add one more nest that was never recorded (J56) and change two nests with 1 female to 2 (J51 and J75) 
# 34 nests had 1 females
# 6 nests had 2 females
# 2 nests had 3 females
# (6+2) / (34+6+2) = 19% are social


# mean number of females
# conservative estimate
beehav_sum %>% filter(Social_status_con == 'social')
# (2 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 3)/ 5  = 2.4
# liberal estimate
beehav_sum %>% filter(Social_status_lib == 'social')

beehav_full %>% filter(Social_status_con == 'social')
```

```{r Pollen_and_Sociality}


### FLower constancy and social status

# insepct bees and samples with both social and pollen data
distinct <- pollen_beehav %>% 
  distinct(Slide_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
# 44 samples with both data
distinct %>% 
  group_by(Site) %>% 
  summarise(Count = (length(unique(Bee_ID))))
# from 24 indivduals (22 JAM, 2 KB)


# flower constancy

# total counts 50
pollen_beehav %>% 
  group_by(Social_status_at_time_con) %>% 
  summarise(Count = (length(unique(Slide_code))))
# 10 social, 34 solitary

pollen_beehav %>% 
  filter(Count_scaled >= 285) %>% 
  count(Social_status_at_time_con)
# 5 social and 20 solitary
# 50% and 59%

# how many bees had sampels as both social and solitary?
soc_and_sol <- pollen_beehav %>%
  group_by(Bee_ID) %>%
  summarise(values = paste(unique(Social_status_at_time_con), collapse = ", "))
# 4: JAM_P-PBG, JAM_W-OWW, JAM_W-PWO, JAM_Y-YPP


# how many samples were in each nest, for social vs solitary? If we had more samples form one type of nest, it could bias it, e.g., 4 samples per social nest but 2 per solitary
slides_per_nest <- pollen_beehav %>% 
  group_by(Social_status_ever_con, Nest) %>% 
  summarise(slide_count = length(unique(Slide_code)))
slides_per_nest %>% 
  group_by(Social_status_ever_con) %>% 
  summarise(mean_slide_count = mean(slide_count))
# 2.4 for social nests
# 1.7 for solitary nests


### Pollen diversity and sociality 

# remove duplicates of nests
pollen_beehav_nests <- pollen_beehav %>% 
  group_by(Nest) %>% 
  distinct(Nest, .keep_all = TRUE)
# keep columns that make sense
pollen_beehav_nests <- pollen_beehav_nests %>% select(Nest, Site, Social_status_at_time_con, Social_status_at_time_lib, Social_status_ever_con, Social_status_ever_lib, Richness_nest, Richness_nest_f)
# how many samples per nest?
num_samples_nest <- pollen_beehav %>% 
  group_by(Nest) %>% 
  summarise(N_samples = length(unique(Slide_code)))
# join together
pollen_beehav_nests <- left_join(pollen_beehav_nests, num_samples_nest)


# remove duplicates of slide codes 
pollen_beehav_ind <- pollen_beehav %>% 
  group_by(Slide_code) %>% 
  distinct(Slide_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
# keep columns that make sense
pollen_beehav_ind <- pollen_beehav_ind %>% select(Nest, Site, Bee_ID, Slide_code, Social_status_at_time_con, Social_status_at_time_lib, Social_status_ever_con, Social_status_ever_lib, Richness_ind, Richness_ind_f)
# how many samples per individual?
num_samples_ind <- pollen_beehav %>% 
  group_by(Bee_ID) %>% 
  summarise(N_samples = length(unique(Slide_code)))
# join together
pollen_beehav_ind <- left_join(pollen_beehav_ind, num_samples_ind)


# GLMM


 ## Individual Level ##

## Individual-level - Subtypes - Conservative
mod_richness_ind_type_con <- glmer(Richness_ind ~ Social_status_at_time_con + Site + (1|Bee_ID), data = pollen_beehav_ind, family = poisson)

check_model(mod_richness_ind_type_con) # great
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_ind_type_con)) # great
summary(mod_richness_ind_type_con) # not significant, no diff with individual ID


## Individual-level - Family - Conservative
mod_richness_ind_fam_con <- glmer(Richness_ind_f ~ Social_status_at_time_con + Site + (1|Bee_ID), data = pollen_beehav_ind, family = poisson)

check_model(mod_richness_ind_fam_con) # great!
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_ind_fam_con))
summary(mod_richness_ind_fam_con) # not significant


## Individual-level - Subtypes - Liberal 
mod_richness_ind_type_lib <- glmer(Richness_ind ~ Social_status_at_time_lib + Site + (1|Bee_ID), data = pollen_beehav_ind, family = poisson)

check_model(mod_richness_ind_type_lib) # great!
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_ind_type_lib))
summary(mod_richness_ind_type_lib) # not significant, no diff with individual ID


## Individual-level - Family - Liberal 
mod_richness_ind_fam_lib <- glmer(Richness_ind_f ~ Social_status_at_time_lib + Site + (1|Bee_ID), data = pollen_beehav_ind, family = poisson)

check_model(mod_richness_ind_fam_lib) # great
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_ind_fam_lib)) # great
summary(mod_richness_ind_fam_lib) # not significant



 ## Nest Level ##

## Nest-level - Subtypes - Conservative
mod_richness_nest_type_con <- lm(Richness_nest ~ Social_status_ever_con + Site + N_samples, data = pollen_beehav_nests)

check_model(mod_richness_nest_type_con) # good
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_nest_type_con)) # good
summary(mod_richness_nest_type_con) # not significant 


## Nest-level - Family - Conservative
mod_richness_nest_fam_con <- lm(Richness_nest_f ~ Social_status_ever_con + Site + N_samples, data = pollen_beehav_nests)

check_model(mod_richness_nest_fam_con) # good
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_nest_fam_con)) # good
summary(mod_richness_nest_fam_con) # not significant


## Nest-level - Subtypes - Liberal
mod_richness_nest_type_lib <- lm(Richness_nest ~ Social_status_ever_lib + Site + N_samples, data = pollen_beehav_nests)

check_model(mod_richness_nest_type_lib) # good
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_nest_type_lib)) # good
summary(mod_richness_nest_type_lib) # significant!


## Nest-level - Family - Liberal
mod_richness_nest_fam_lib <- lm(Richness_nest_f ~ Social_status_ever_lib + Site + N_samples, data = pollen_beehav_nests)

check_model(mod_richness_nest_fam_lib) # good
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_richness_nest_fam_lib)) # good
summary(mod_richness_nest_fam_lib) # significant!


## Make a table

# make list of models with descriptors
pollen_and_social_models <- list(
  "individual_conservative_type"   = mod_richness_ind_type_con,
  "individual_conservative_family" = mod_richness_ind_fam_con,
  "individual_liberal_type"        = mod_richness_ind_type_lib,
  "individual_liberal_family"      = mod_richness_ind_fam_lib,
  "nest_conservative_type"         = mod_richness_nest_type_con,
  "nest_conservative_family"       = mod_richness_nest_fam_con,
  "nest_liberal_type"              = mod_richness_nest_type_lib,
  "nest_liberal_family"            = mod_richness_nest_fam_lib
)


library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)

# round up function because just round() wasn't working
round_half_up <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  sign(x) * floor(abs(x) * 10^digits + 0.5 + 1e-9) / 10^digits
}

# make table
pollen_and_social_results <- map_dfr(pollen_and_social_models, tidy, .id = "model") %>% 
  filter(str_detect(term, "^Social_status")) %>% 
  separate(model, into = c("Richness", "Social", "Taxa"), sep = "_") %>% 
  select(Richness, Social, Taxa, B = estimate, SE = std.error, P = p.value) %>% 
  mutate(
    B  = sprintf("%.2f", round_half_up(B, 2)),
    SE = sprintf("%.2f", round_half_up(SE, 2)),
    P  = if_else(
      P < 0.05,
      sprintf("%.3f", round_half_up(P, 3)),
      sprintf("%.2f", round_half_up(P, 2))
    )
  )

# save as csv
write.csv(pollen_and_social_results, "Data/Tables/Output_ollen_and_social.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

```{r Flower_Constancy}
### Flower constancy

# how many samples are above 95% of one pollen type
pollen_samples %>% 
  filter(Count_scaled >= 285) %>% 
  summarise(count = length(unique(Slide_code)))
# 46 out of 83 samples = 55%


# how many samples from how many individuals 
pollen_samples %>% 
  summarise(count = length(unique(Slide_code)))
# 83 samples 
pollen_samples %>% 
  summarise(count = length(unique(Bee_ID)))
# 49 individuals

# average number of samples
mean_num_samples <- pollen_samples %>% 
  group_by(Bee_ID) %>% 
  summarise(count = mean(Num_of_samples, na.rm = TRUE))
mean(mean_num_samples$count)
# 1.7 


# flower constancy of sample (yes or no) ~ floral abundance + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | pollen type) + (1 | bee ID) 


# make column to say flower constant or not
pollen_samples_abundance <- pollen_samples_abundance %>% mutate(Flower_constant = ifelse(Count_scaled >= 285, 1, 0))
pollen_samples_abundance_fam <- pollen_samples_abundance_fam %>% mutate(Flower_constant = ifelse(Count_scaled >= 285, 1, 0))

# make it only plants collected
pollen_samples_abundance_coll <- pollen_samples_abundance %>% 
  filter(Count_scaled > 0)
pollen_samples_abundance_fam_coll <- pollen_samples_abundance_fam %>% 
  filter(Count_scaled > 0)

# plot
pollen_samples_abundance_coll %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Abundance_for50, fill = factor(Flower_constant), colour = factor(Flower_constant))) +
  geom_histogram(position = 'dodge')
pollen_samples_abundance_fam_coll %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Abundance_for50_comp_all, fill = factor(Flower_constant), colour = factor(Flower_constant))) +
  geom_histogram(position = 'dodge')


# GLMM

 ## 50 m ##

# 50 - subtypes
mod_flow_cons_50 <- glmer(Flower_constant ~ Abundance_for50 + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Subtype) + (1 | Num_ID / Slide_code), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = pollen_samples_abundance_coll)

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_flow_cons_50)) # good
summary(mod_flow_cons_50) # not sig


# 50 - family
mod_flow_cons_50_fam <- glmer(Flower_constant ~ Abundance_for50_comp_all + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Family) + (1 | Num_ID / Slide_code), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = pollen_samples_abundance_fam_coll)

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_flow_cons_50_fam)) # fine
summary(mod_flow_cons_50_fam) # not sig


 ## 200 m ##

# 200 - subtypes
mod_flow_cons_200 <- glmer(Flower_constant ~ Abundance_for200 + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Subtype) + (1 | Num_ID / Slide_code), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = pollen_samples_abundance_coll)

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_flow_cons_200)) # good
summary(mod_flow_cons_200) # not sig

# 200 - family
mod_flow_cons_200_fam <- glmer(Flower_constant ~ Abundance_for200_comp_all + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Family) + (1 | Num_ID / Slide_code), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = pollen_samples_abundance_fam_coll)

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_flow_cons_200_fam)) # best we can get
summary(mod_flow_cons_200_fam) # not sig


## Make tables

# make a function to be used for these tables and the floral aubundance GLMMs
make_model_table <- function(mod) {
  broom.mixed::tidy(mod, effects = c("fixed", "ran_pars")) %>% 
    filter(term != "(Intercept)" | effect != "fixed") %>% 
    mutate(
      Effect = if_else(effect == "fixed", "Fixed", "Random"),
      Term = case_when(
        effect == "fixed"         ~ term,
        term == "sd__Observation" ~ "Residual",
        term == "sd__(Intercept)" ~ group,
        TRUE                      ~ paste0(group, ": ", str_remove(term, "^(sd|cor)__"))
      )
    ) %>% 
    select(Effect, Term, Estimate = estimate, `Standard Error` = std.error, P = p.value) %>% 
    mutate(
      Estimate = sprintf("%.2f", round_half_up(Estimate, 2)),
      `Standard Error` = if_else(is.na(`Standard Error`), "",
                                 sprintf("%.2f", round_half_up(`Standard Error`, 2))),
      `P-value` = case_when(
        is.na(P)  ~ "",
        P < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        P < 0.05  ~ sprintf("%.3f", round_half_up(P, 3)),
        TRUE      ~ sprintf("%.2f", round_half_up(P, 2))
      )
    ) %>% 
    select(-P)
}

# apply funciton
tab_flow_cons_50_fam <- make_model_table(mod_flow_cons_50_fam)
tab_flow_cons_200_fam <- make_model_table(mod_flow_cons_200_fam)

# save
write.csv(tab_flow_cons_50_fam, "Data/Tables/Output_flow_cons_50_fam.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tab_flow_cons_200_fam, "Data/Tables/Output_flow_cons_200_fam.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Pollen_Composition_PERMANOVA}


## PERMANOVA with pollen subtypes

# use bees caught more than once, otherwise the single sample bees will inflate between-individual differences
pollen_samples_multi <- pollen_samples %>% filter(Num_of_samples > 1)


# take columns
pollen_samples_wide <- pollen_samples_multi %>% select(Num_ID, Slide_code, Site, Subtype, Count_scaled)
# pivot wider
pollen_samples_wide <- pivot_wider(pollen_samples_wide, names_from = 'Subtype', values_from = 'Count_scaled', id_cols = c(Num_ID, Slide_code, Site))
# replace NA with 0
pollen_samples_wide[is.na(pollen_samples_wide)] <- 0
# remove non-numeric columns
pollen_samples_wide_num <- pollen_samples_wide %>% select(-Num_ID, -Slide_code, -Site)
# take descriptive columns
pollen_samples_wide_desc <- pollen_samples_wide %>% select(Num_ID, Slide_code, Site)

# make vectar of bee IDs
Num_ID <- pollen_samples_wide$Num_ID

# make Bray-Curtis distance of the pollen samples
samples_distance <- vegdist(pollen_samples_wide_num, method = "bray")

# is the variance assumption violated?
variance <- betadisper(samples_distance, pollen_samples_wide_desc$Num_ID)
anova(variance)
# not sig, so not violated

# PERMANOVA 
permanova <- adonis2(samples_distance ~ Num_ID, 
        data = pollen_samples_wide_desc, 
        method = "bray",
        permutations = 999) 

permanova


## PERMANOVA with pollen compilled at family level

# take columns
pollen_samples_wide_fam <- pollen_samples_multi %>% select(Num_ID, Slide_code, Site, Family, Count_scaled)
# pivot wider 
pollen_samples_wide_fam <- pivot_wider(pollen_samples_wide_fam, names_from = 'Family', values_from = 'Count_scaled', id_cols = c(Num_ID, Slide_code, Site))
# replace NA with 0
pollen_samples_wide_fam[is.na(pollen_samples_wide_fam)] <- 0
# remove non-numeric columns
pollen_samples_wide_fam_num <- pollen_samples_wide_fam %>% select(-Num_ID, -Slide_code, -Site)
# take descriptive columns
pollen_samples_wide_fam_desc <- pollen_samples_wide_fam %>% select(Num_ID, Slide_code, Site)

# make vectar of bee IDs
Num_ID_fam <- pollen_samples_wide_fam$Num_ID

# make Bray-Curtis distance of the pollen samples
samples_distance_fam <- vegdist(pollen_samples_wide_fam_num, method = "bray")

# is the variance assumption violated?
variance_fam <- betadisper(samples_distance_fam, pollen_samples_wide_fam_desc$Num_ID)
anova(variance_fam)
# not sig, so not violated

# PERMANOVA 
permanova_fam <- adonis2(samples_distance_fam ~ Num_ID_fam, 
        data = pollen_samples_wide_fam_desc, 
        method = "bray",
        permutations = 999) 

permanova_fam
permanova
# both not sig

```

```{r Pollen_Diversity_and_Richness, include=FALSE}
### Pollen collection divserity 

# plot richness over time

  filter(Num_of_samples == 2) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Day_of_season, y = Num_of_subtypes, colour = Bee_ID)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, width = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_line()

# bees with >2 samples
pollen_samples %>%
  filter(Num_of_samples > 2) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Day_of_season, y = Num_of_subtypes, colour = Bee_ID)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, width = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_line()

# bees with 1 sample
pollen_samples %>%
  filter(Num_of_samples == 1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Day_of_season, y = Num_of_subtypes, colour = Bee_ID)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, width = 0.3, alpha = 0.7)
```

```{r Floral_Abundance_GLM}

### Floral abundance

# replace NAs with 0
pollen_samples_abundance <- pollen_samples_abundance %>%
  mutate(Abundance_for50 = replace_na(Abundance_for50, 0))
pollen_samples_abundance_fam <- pollen_samples_abundance_fam %>%
  mutate(Abundance_for50_comp_all = replace_na(Abundance_for50_comp_all, 0))


 ## 50 m ##

# 50 m radius with subtypes
mod_abun_50 <- glmmTMB(cbind(Count_scaled, 300 - Count_scaled) ~ Abundance_for50 + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Subtype) + (1 | Num_ID),
        family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
        data = pollen_samples_abundance)

check_model(mod_abun_50) # great
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_abun_50)) # minor issue
testDispersion(mod_abun_50) # no overdispersion
testZeroInflation(mod_abun_50) # no zero inflation
testOutliers(mod_abun_50) # no sig outliers
# so trust the summary
summary(mod_abun_50)


# 50 m at family level
mod_abun_50_f <- glmmTMB(cbind(Count_scaled, 300 - Count_scaled) ~ Abundance_for50_comp_all + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Family) + (1 | Num_ID),
        family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
        data = pollen_samples_abundance_fam)
check_model(mod_abun_50_f) # great
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_abun_50_f)) # minor issue
testDispersion(mod_abun_50_f) # no overdispersion
testZeroInflation(mod_abun_50_f) # no zero inflation
testOutliers(mod_abun_50_f) # no sig outliers
# so trust the summary
summary(mod_abun_50_f)


## 200 m ##

# 200 m radius grouped at subtype
mod_abun_200 <- glmmTMB(cbind(Count_scaled, 300 - Count_scaled) ~ Abundance_for200 + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Subtype) + (1 | Num_ID),
        family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
        data = pollen_samples_abundance)

check_model(mod_abun_200) # great
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_abun_200)) # minor issues again
testDispersion(mod_abun_200) # no overdispersion
testZeroInflation(mod_abun_200) # no zero inflation
testOutliers(mod_abun_200) # no outliers
# trust summary
summary(mod_abun_200)


# 200 m grouped at family 
mod_abun_200_f <- glmmTMB(cbind(Count_scaled, 300 - Count_scaled) ~ Abundance_for200_comp_all + Day_of_season + Site + (1 | Family) + (1 | Num_ID),
        family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
        data = pollen_samples_abundance_fam)
check_model(mod_abun_200_f) # great
plot(simulateResiduals(mod_abun_200_f)) # good
testDispersion(mod_abun_200_f) # no overdispersion
testZeroInflation(mod_abun_200_f) # no zero inflation
testOutliers(mod_abun_200_f) # no outliers
# trust summary
summary(mod_abun_200_f)

# which model fits better?
AIC(mod_abun_50) # 2055.583 
AIC(mod_abun_200) # 2062.732 
AIC(mod_abun_200) - AIC(mod_abun_50) # 50m model fits better by 7 units

AIC(mod_abun_50_f) # 2009.58
AIC(mod_abun_200_f) # 2028.609
AIC(mod_abun_200_f) - AIC(mod_abun_50_f) # 50m model fits better by 19 units


## Make tables

# apply function 
tab_abun_50_f <- make_model_table(mod_abun_50_f)
tab_abun_200_f <- make_model_table(mod_abun_200_f)

write.csv(tab_abun_50_f, "Data/Tables/Output_abun_50_fam.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tab_abun_200_f, "Data/Tables/Output_abun_200_fam.csv", row.names = FALSE)



```
